heading: 17.6 Slot `tolerance` is a physical deadband
text:
### 17.6 Slot `tolerance` is a physical deadband [LUNI.17.6]

The `tolerance` keyword on a schema slot declares a physical deadband Δ in the
slot's dimension ([LUNI.7.4]). It has no other meaning: a series observation
line takes no accuracy phrase ([LSER.15.1]).
